meta.title: Add high-performance loggers to credential providers
meta.body_summary: Replace ad-hoc logging with high-performance loggers using LoggerMessage.Define (later changed to [LoggerMessage] attribute) in OidcFIC credential providers to reduce allocations and improve performance.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot replaced ad-hoc logging with high-performance loggers; keegan-caruso CHANGES_REQUESTED [LoggerMessage] pattern; Copilot made changes but PR closed without merge despite fixes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 307 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, concentrated in two new logger files and minor modifications to existing classes. It fits a small-step performance PR that was closed without merge after addressing design feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer keegan-caruso requested using [LoggerMessage] attribute and extension methods instead of LoggerMessage.Define, and that main classes should not be partial. Copilot updated the implementation accordingly.
review_details.performance_claim: Pre-compiled delegates avoid string interpolation overhead, reducing allocations and improving logging performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without merge after changes; no further review.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent successfully adopted requested logging pattern after explicit guidance, but PR remained unmerged due to lack of follow-up review.

detection_detail.code_reading: keegan-caruso reviewed the code and provided exact [LoggerMessage] examples to follow.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or timing data; only narrative claims about performance improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge despite address of review feedback.

core_change_summary.description: Added high-performance loggers using LoggerMessage.Define initially, then switched to [LoggerMessage] attribute pattern and extension methods in OidcIdpSignedAssertionLoader and OidcIdpSignedAssertionProvider, replacing ad-hoc logger calls.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: global.json change in second commit is unrelated (SDK version bump); main classes only had import and call adjustments.
change_trajectory: First implementation using LoggerMessage.Define in two new logger partial classes and updates to main classes.
After CHANGES_REQUESTED: replaced LoggerMessage.Define with [LoggerMessage] attribute, removed partial from non-logger classes.

review_signals.summary: CHANGES_REQUESTED with no body; substantive feedback via inline comments.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot pushed commit fd3a87c addressing all inline feedback.

review_signals.summary: Main classes shouldn't be partial; only the logger class requires partial.
review_signals.action_taken: Removed partial keyword from main classes in fd3a87c.

review_signals.summary: Requested using [LoggerMessage] attribute and extension methods with concrete examples.
review_signals.action_taken: Replaced LoggerMessage.Define with attribute-based pattern in fd3a87c.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot confirmed that the requested changes were applied in commit fd3a87c.
